description: This file is a JavaScript script for Node.js that facilitates running test extensions using Vitest. It contains functions for spawning child processes, handling command-line arguments, and executing test plans for extensions.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Asynchronously runs a batch of Vitest tests in a child process, handling process exit codes and signals.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: printNoTestsMessage
methods.description: Logs a message indicating no tests were found for a given extension plan.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, resolves the extension test plan, and executes tests.
